title: Verified device and charger dimensions are missing
root_cause: PO measurement evidence has not been supplied
solution: Collect the requested watch charger and cable measurements with evidence

title: Printer and material profile are undefined
root_cause: Printer nozzle material and profile inputs have not been supplied
solution: PO confirms the intended printer setup and manufacturing constraints

title: Commercial character licensing basis is unresolved
root_cause: Commercial-use rights or an original character direction have not been established
solution: PO defines intended use and selects an original or appropriately licensed character

title: IP68 claim does not establish charging suitability
root_cause: The simulation dataset includes water resistance without evidence applicable to charging
solution: Obtain manufacturer guidance or PO-confirmed test evidence before making a charging-suitability claim

title: Supplier claims lack source provenance
root_cause: Fields labeled supplier_verified have no cited source version or retrieval date
solution: Attach an authoritative supplier source with version or date before relying on the claims

title: Simulation measurement list has ambiguous YAML indentation
root_cause: The cable exit direction item is outside the apparent measurements_required list
solution: Correct and validate the source dataset without treating the correction as evidence
